ANSWER: <value>
Numbers: digits only, no units. Yes/no questions: yes or no. Multiple choice: the letter only. Orderings: the step letters in order, separated by commas.

Values are peak-to-peak amplitudes in microvolts (uV) per channel for each epoch.

| Epoch | Fz | Cz | Pz |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 92 | 127 | 88 |
| 2 | 54 | 63 | 39 |
| 3 | 59 | 95 | 130 |
| 4 | 45 | 120 | 305 |
| 5 | 39 | 67 | 53 |

| 7 | 28 | 340 | 127 |
| 8 | 27 | 132 | 58 |
| 9 | 117 | 51 | 55 |
| 10 | 45 | 84 | 299 |
| 11 | 89 | 285 | 97 |

Rule: reject an epoch if the peak-to-peak amplitude on any channel is greater than 135 uV.

How many epochs survive?

End your reply with a final line of the form: ANSWER: <value>

You are ordering the steps of a cross-subject decoding analysis. The steps, in arbitrary order:
A. Cut labeled epochs from every participant's recording
B. Train the classifier on the training group's epochs
C. Z-score the training and test epochs using the training-group statistics
D. Compute channel-wise mean and standard deviation on the training group only
E. Predict labels for the test group's epochs

Constraints:
- Doing step C before step D fails: there are no statistics to normalize with yet.
- Doing step D before step A fails: the statistics are computed over epochs.
- Doing step B before step C fails: a classifier trained on unnormalized data cannot be applied to normalized test data.
- Doing step E before step B fails: there is no trained model to predict with.

Exactly one order satisfies every constraint. Give the step letters in the order they are performed, separated by commas.

End your reply with a final line of the form: ANSWER: <value>
